name: UCLA孤独量表
instructions: 以下问题涉及您与他人的关系。请根据您的实际感受作答。
instructionsEn: The following questions concern your relationships with others. Please answer according to how you actually feel.
license: Russell 编制，可免费用于非商业用途，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 我觉得自己与周围的人相处融洽。
items.textEn: I feel that I am in tune with the people around me.

items.text: 我感到自己缺乏朋友。
items.textEn: I feel that I lack companionship.

items.text: 我觉得没有人可以依靠。
items.textEn: I feel that I have no one to rely on.

items.text: 我感到孤单。
items.textEn: I feel lonely.

items.text: 我觉得自己是朋友圈中的一员。
items.textEn: I feel that I am part of a group of friends.

items.text: 我和周围的人有许多共同之处。
items.textEn: I have a lot in common with the people around me.

items.text: 我觉得自己不再与任何人亲近。
items.textEn: I feel that I am no longer close to anyone.

items.text: 我觉得周围的人与我没有共同的兴趣和想法。
items.textEn: I feel that the people around me do not share my interests and ideas.

items.text: 我觉得自己为人外向、友善。
items.textEn: I feel that I am an outgoing and friendly person.

items.text: 我感到与他人关系亲密。
items.textEn: I feel close to other people.

items.text: 我感到自己被冷落。
items.textEn: I feel left out.

items.text: 我觉得与别人的关系没有意义。
items.textEn: I feel that my relationships with others are not meaningful.

items.text: 我感到没有人真正了解我。
items.textEn: I feel that no one really knows me well.

items.text: 我感到与他人隔绝。
items.textEn: I feel isolated from others.

items.text: 我想要陪伴时总能找到伙伴。
items.textEn: I can always find companionship when I want it.

items.text: 我觉得有人真正理解我。
items.textEn: I feel that there are people who truly understand me.

items.text: 我容易感到害羞。
items.textEn: I easily feel shy.

items.text: 我觉得人们虽在身边，却并不与我为伴。
items.textEn: I feel that people are around me but not with me.

items.text: 我有可以交谈的人。
items.textEn: I have someone I can talk to.

items.text: 我有可以求助的人。
items.textEn: I have someone I can turn to for help.

totalBands.description: 总分低于35，孤独感较低，社交关系良好。
总分35-50，存在中等程度的孤独感。
总分50-65，孤独感较高，建议关注社交健康。
总分65及以上，孤独感极高，建议寻求专业帮助。
